nodes.label: Setup Composite Action (QEMU + Buildx)
nodes.rationale: Stops docker, mounts a maximized virtual volume at /var/lib/docker (about 97G as of 2/14/2024), then restarts docker, because the default GitHub runner disk cannot hold Frigate's multi-stage images. Emits image-name and cache-name outputs derived from the lowercased repo and the 7-char short SHA so every build job tags consistently.
